name: Paprika Salmon with Grilled Eggplant & Basil Vinaigrette

cookwares.name: grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet

instructions.primary_message: Heat a grill pan, outdoor grill, or skillet over medium-high heat.
In a small bowl, mix together oil, paprika, cumin, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 tsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp paprika
⅜ tsp cumin
⅜ tsp salt
⅜ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Coat grill or bottom of skillet with oil. Add salmon and cook until opaque, 4-5 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Wash, dry, and slice eggplant into ⅔ cm thick pieces. Transfer to a large bowl, drizzle with oil, and season with salt; toss to coat.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 eggplant
3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
⅜ tsp salt

instructions.primary_message: Add eggplant to grill/skillet and cook until tender and lightly browned, 2-3 minutes per side.
Wash and dry basil. Pick leaves off the stems; discard the stems and mince the leaves. Peel and mince garlic. In a medium bowl, whisk together basil, garlic, oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
1 ½ small pkg fresh basil
3 cloves garlic
6 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
3 tbsp red wine vinegar
3 pinches salt
3 pinches black pepper

instructions.primary_message: To serve, place salmon and eggplant on a plate and drizzle with basil vinaigrette. Enjoy!
